title: One letter in front
prompt:
Put the same single letter in front of each of these four words to make four new words:

- HOST
- LOVE
- RAVE
- OLD

Once you have found the letter, what word does HOST become?
hints: Which of the four words lets the fewest different letters go in front of it?
Very few letters can go in front of HOST to make a word, so which ones can you find?
Which letters can go in front of OLD to make a word, and which of those also work in front of HOST?
solution:
**GHOST.**

The letter is G: GHOST, GLOVE, GRAVE, GOLD.

Start with HOST, because it accepts the fewest letters. G is the only common one. Other letters fail on HOST even though they work elsewhere. For example, C gives CLOVE, CRAVE and COLD, but CHOST is not a word. So HOST becomes GHOST.
